{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Pelican''''' was a group of 6 [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. When [[XQ2 Platform]] ''[[I.N. Depot]]'' was disabled by [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], '''Pelican''' then arrived to steel the containers from the Depot thinkning that the Rebel fighters had cleared up the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] at the location. Instead, the lifters were all destroyed by the TIE fighters reinforced by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star destroyer]] [[Colossus (Star Destroyer)|Colossus]] before they could escape to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] with the supplies.

The event was recorded and recreated in the [[Combat chamber]] to train Imperial [[TIE pilot|pilots]], one of them was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
